title: Lucy Teaches Grandma to Video Call
passage: Lucy's grandmother, who lives in a small town, missed her family very much because they lived far away. One day, Lucy decided to teach her grandmother how to use a smartphone to make video calls. At first, Grandma was confused and said she wasn't used to touching a screen. "I used to write letters instead," she laughed. Lucy patiently showed her step by step. She explained that it would take only a few minutes to learn, and that video calls were much faster than letters. Lucy opened the app, which had a simple design, and tapped the green button to start a call with her uncle, who was studying abroad. When her uncle's face appeared on the screen, Grandma was so excited that she almost dropped the phone! "I can really see you!" she said happily. They talked for almost an hour, sharing news about the weather, the garden, and even the neighbor's noisy dog. After the call ended, Grandma told Lucy that she was getting used to the new technology already. "Maybe I'll even learn to send photos next," she said with a smile. Lucy felt proud that she had helped her grandmother connect with family members who lived so far away. From then on, Grandma video-called her children and grandchildren every weekend, and she never felt lonely again.

grammar: used to + 原形動詞 (過去的習慣) vs. be/get used to + V-ing（習慣於）：used to + 原形動詞表示「過去常常做、但現在已不再如此」的習慣；be/get used to + V-ing（或名詞）表示「習慣於...」。例：I used to write letters instead.（過去習慣寫信）/ Grandma was getting used to the new technology.（逐漸習慣新科技）
關係代詞 who / which 引導形容詞子句：who 代替「人」，which 代替「事物」，用來修飾前面的名詞並補充說明。例：Lucy's grandmother, who lives in a small town, missed her family. / Lucy opened the app, which had a simple design.
It takes + (某人) + 時間 + to V：表示「做某事需要花...時間」。例：It would take only a few minutes to learn.
